a registered user with role `\"player\"`.\n    Player,\n}\n\n/// Extract a `Bearer` token from the `Authorization` header, if present.\nfn extract_auth_token(req: &str) -> Option<&str> {\n    for line AuthRequirement,\n) -> Result<String, auth::AuthError> {\n    let token = extract_auth_token(req).ok_or(auth::AuthError::Unauthorized)?;\n    let (username, role) = auth::verify_bearer(token,         sessions.clear();\n                // Preserve registered user accounts across storage reset so that\n                // the authenticated play surface can still identify DMs/players\n with the highest vote count and at least one vote has been cast.\n/// Ties and voteless records return `None`.\nfn compute_loot_winner(\n    campaign_id: &str,\n    loot_id: &str,\n) -> Result<Option<(String, i64)>, PlayError> {\n    let counts = play_loot_votes_count_by_recipient(campaign_id, loot_id)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if counts.is_empty() {\n        return Ok(None);\n    }\n    let max_votes = counts.iter().map(|(_, c)| *c).max().unwrap_or(0);\n    if max_votes == 0 {\n        return Ok(None);\n    }\n    let leaders: Vec<(String, i64)> = counts\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter(|(_, c)| *c == max_votes)\n        .collect();\n    if leaders.len() != 1 {\n        return Ok(None);\n    }\n    Ok(Some(leaders.into_iter().next().unwrap()))\n}\n\n/// Create a new campaign-scoped loot record.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/loot\n///\n/// Only the campaign owner may create loot. The item must be a known inventory\n/// catalog item and the quantity must be positive. Duplicate loot ids within\n/// the same campaign return 409.\npub fn create_loot(\n    campaign_id: &str,\n    body: &str,\n    actor: &str,\n) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n    let (owner, _status) =\n        play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Forbidden);\n    }\n    let loot_id = extract_string(body, \"loot_id\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let item_id = extract_string(body, \"item_id\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let quantity = extract_int(body, \"quantity\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if loot_id.is_empty() || item_id.is_empty() || quantity < 1 {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    let is_catalog_item = valid_inventory_item(item_id)\n        || compendium_slug_exists(\"items\", item_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if !is_catalog_item {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    if play_loot_exists(campaign_id, loot_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    play_loot_create(campaign_id, loot_id, item_id, quantity).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"loot_id\":\"{}\",\"item_id\":\"{}\",\"quantity\":{},\"status\":\"open\"}}\"#,\n        escape_json(loot_id),\n        escape_json(item_id),\n        quantity\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Cast a vote for a loot recipient.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/loot/{loot_id}/votes\n///\n/// Only campaign members may vote. play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let is_member =\n        play_campaign_member_exists(campaign_id, actor).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if
